name: 智能感应柔光美妆镜款
description: 感应亮灭、光色可调、带收纳底座的台式美妆镜套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating warm terracotta field #B57049, soft blush beige #F3DED2 panels, deep teal accents #4F6E6A and clean warm white #FFFFFF information screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the upper left with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, luminous glow edges only inside infographic elements
styleLock.surfaceSystem: grey-veined marble vanity counter #EDEAE6 and matte geometric riser cubes
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square outline icons, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright tabletop-mirror hero angle and scale across the set, blank mirror faces with no readouts
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium beauty-tool appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of terracotta clay #B57049, deep teal #4F6E6A, soft blush beige #F3DED2 and warm white #FFFFFF; warm soft studio lighting with an upper-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line rounded-square icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright tabletop-mirror hero angle and scale with blank mirror faces; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏以双镜组合与暖色块在列表中一眼赢得点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level view of two upright tabletop mirror units staggered at different heights on riser cubes
shots.lighting: warm soft studio key from the upper left with gentle fill, soft contact shadows grounding each base
shots.background: warm terracotta gradient #B57049 with one deep teal riser cube #4F6E6A and one rust-orange riser cube
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper-left 35% reserved for the headline
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero photograph of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two units of the product staged at staggered heights on geometric riser cubes, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level view. Warm soft studio key light from the upper left with gentle fill, soft contact shadows grounding each base; the mirror faces render as blank even white with no readouts, numbers or reflections. Warm terracotta gradient background #B57049 with one deep teal riser cube #4F6E6A. The two units together occupy 55-60% of the frame, generous negative space in the upper-left 35% reserved for the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF. 8K commercial ecommerce quality. Negative: no brand wordmarks or store badges, no QR codes, no invented brightness or color-temperature numbers, no readouts or scenery rendered inside the mirror glass, no garbled text, no floating product without contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1主视觉为两台米白细斑纹台式化妆镜立于陶土与墨青方块上，标题为柔光双智能美妆镜子、副题为智能感应开启熄灭环境光，左上品牌字标已剥离；屏2陶土底六宫格（无极调光/高亮LED/防爆玻璃，两组重复）改为三卡占位；屏3感光说明（靠近点亮离开熄灭）配两枚胶囊文案，其中距离与熄灭时长数值已剥离，实拍女性对镜描眉的模特面容已剥离；屏4三光效圆环图中暖光冷光自然光三档均标注同一色温区间，自相矛盾，且标注灯珠数与供应商实验室来源，全部数值不写入，仅保留三色光环结构；屏5灯效记忆模式说明与三张文字雷同的白卡，文字全部改为占位；屏6双镜底座置于大理石台面，调光滑动与档位数值剥离；屏7引线标注亮度、色温、开关四项与白卡柔光罩及散热寿命断言，功效断言剥离仅留结构；屏8两张重复白卡与带矛盾品牌字的产品信息标题，品牌字剥离；屏9参数表（型号、电压电流、线长、材质、时长等）行项重复且字段与供电结构自相矛盾，全部数值改为空白占位行，左下角会员角标与二维码剥离。品类判定依据：屏1品名为美妆镜子，结构带灯环与感应窗，屏9参数区有电压电流供电字段，屏4有三色光与调光功能，属带电个护照明器具，故判家用电器/个护电器而非美妆工具或家居日用；与库内电动洁面美容仪同属个护电器但leaf不同，slug全新。已剥离：原品牌中英文字标（含屏8矛盾徽标）、二维码、会员促销角标、模特面容、原文案原句与全部规格数值，产品一律以{product}占位。
